endorsements.label: The Luna Correspondence Protocol
endorsements.description: The Luna Correspondence Protocol is an anonymous finitely improbable data dispersal and stealth security nexus. Elaborated, Luna is a protocol designed to ensure traffic travelling across the internet can't be snooped by prying eyes. Luna is the greatest and best attempt--to date--at purely anonymous and secure data transmission by commingling various techniques involving encryption, data relaying and mathematics--absolutely not security by obscurity.
